variants.title: Op-amp frequency response and gain-bandwidth with an LF351
variants.unknown: the gain-bandwidth product of the LF351
variants.note: The JFET-input LF351 has about four times the 741's gain-bandwidth product, so each gain keeps its gain four times further up in frequency.

source.title: LF351 data sheet (Texas Instruments): gain-bandwidth 4 MHz, open-loop gain about 100 V/mV
